description: Which files of a gold folder may be served to which reader. serve: audience-only = only readers of that audience (a keyed folder only to the owner of the key); central-only = only the central team; never = no reader, only the people who run the build. contains_person_keys: a file under the pattern holds pseudonymous person or manager keys, in a column or in a path. hidden_marker: the name of the column that marks withheld values in the files under the pattern, or null. The prose twin is the table 'What a build writes' in the meterline-gold README; a test holds the two together.
